summary.description: One or two sentences on what the change does and its overall risk.

line.description: Line in the head revision, or 0 for a file-level finding.

detail.description: Why it matters: what triggers the problem and its concrete result, and the fix when clear. A short Markdown paragraph with no headings.

needed.description: Whether a person must judge the change before it merges.

reasons.description: The questions a person must answer to approve, one each, naming the file or behavior. Empty when not needed.

reviewer.description: A login from reviewers.jsonl, or empty.

reviewer_reason.description: Why that reviewer fits, as a short phrase, or empty.

not_checked.description: What a person would still have to verify that this review could not, one sentence each. Empty when nothing.

reviewed_closely.description: False when the change is too large to review closely or hides content, so a person must read the code too.
